description: This file defines the ValidationBehavior class, which implements a pipeline behavior for request validation in a MediatR-based CQRS pattern. It coordinates multiple validators to potentially prevent requests with validation failures from proceeding.

classes.name: ValidationBehavior
classes.description: A generic pipeline behavior that validates incoming requests using a set of validators before passing the request to the next delegate.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes request validation asynchronously, throws exception if validation fails, otherwise proceeds with the next behavior in the pipeline.
